mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days. The signal is always active regardless of regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 90th percentile, 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During early expansion cycles (INDPRO growth > 1.0% YoY), industrial production growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In early expansion cycles (INDPRO growth > 1.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 2.5% YoY (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% YoY, 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 predicting 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases by more than 100k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp in the same month, 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In early monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS falling below 0.5%), cheap capital supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In early monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS falling from above 1.0% to below 0.5% in last 3 months), 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.
